scientific_integrity: Universal validity follows from an analytic convexity reduction and an exact square factorization. Numerical checks are supplementary and are not used to infer the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: Proves Liu Conjecture 3.12 only for the full isosceles class AB=AC; the scalene case remains outside the claim. Originality remains subject to the possibility of unindexed or differently phrased literature.
title: An exact altitude reduction for Liu's Oppenheim-ratio conjecture on isosceles triangles
